)


def codec_failure_diagnostic(token):
    """Return a bounded diagnostic command for an already failed codec call.

    The caller saves the command-substitution status before any other command.
    Only a complete three-field rejection with a known finite reason may expose
    that reason. No arbitrary codec output, image data, page or viewport is
    copied into this diagnostic. Original stderr and the EXIT trap are unchanged.
    """
    require(isinstance(token, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{32}', token),
            'codec diagnostic requires the existing capture identity')
    blank = '[[:blank:]]*'
    fields = (
        '"schema"' + blank + ':' + blank + '"hepta[.]phone-screenshot[.]v1"',
        '"status"' + blank + ':' + blank + '"rejected"',
        '"reason"' + blank + ':' + blank + '"[a-z0-9_]{1,80}"',
    )
    orders = ((0, 1, 2), (0, 2, 1), (1, 0, 2),
              (1, 2, 0), (2, 0, 1), (2, 1, 0))
    pattern = blank + '[{]' + blank + '(' + '|'.join(
        (blank + ',' + blank).join(fields[i] for i in order)
        for order in orders) + ')' + blank + '[}]' + blank
    extract = 's/.*"reason"[[:blank:]]*:[[:blank:]]*"\\([a-z0-9_]*\\)".*/\\1/p'
    template = ('{"schema":"hepta.capture-codec-failure.v1","capture_id":"' + token
                + '","codec_shell_status":%s,"native_failure_status_before_cleanup":72,'
                '"stdout_observation":"shell_variable_after_command_substitution",'
                '"codec_stdout_normalized_bytes":%s,"classification":"%s",'
                '"reason":%s,"raw_codec_stdout_emitted":false,'
                '"screenshot_payload_emitted":false}\n')
    shell = 'hepta_codec_kind=unrecognized; hepta_codec_reason_json=null; '
    shell += ('hepta_codec_bytes=$(printf \'%s\' "$hepta_codec" | wc -c | '
              'tr -d \'[:space:]\') || hepta_codec_bytes=unavailable; ')
    shell += ('case "$hepta_codec_bytes" in \'\'|*[!0-9]*) '
              'hepta_codec_bytes=null; hepta_codec_kind=diagnostic_unavailable;; *) '
              'if [ "${#hepta_codec_bytes}" -gt 20 ]; then '
              'hepta_codec_bytes=null; hepta_codec_kind=diagnostic_unavailable; '
              'elif [ "$hepta_codec_bytes" = 0 ]; then hepta_codec_kind=empty; '
              'elif [ "${#hepta_codec_bytes}" -gt 3 ] || [ "$hepta_codec_bytes" -gt '
              + str(CODEC_FAILURE_JSON_MAX_BYTES) + ' ]; then hepta_codec_kind=oversized; else ')
    shell += ('if [ "$(printf \'%s\' "$hepta_codec" | tr -d \'\\r\\n\')" = "$hepta_codec" ] '
              '&& printf \'%s\\n\' "$hepta_codec" | LC_ALL=C grep -Ex '
              + shlex.quote(pattern) + ' >/dev/null; then ')
    shell += ('hepta_codec_reason=$(printf \'%s\\n\' "$hepta_codec" | LC_ALL=C sed -n '
              + shlex.quote(extract) + ') || hepta_codec_reason=; ')
    shell += ('case "$hepta_codec_reason" in ' + '|'.join(CODEC_FAILURE_REASONS)
              + ') hepta_codec_kind=recognized_rejection; '
              'hepta_codec_reason_json=$(printf \'"%s"\' "$hepta_codec_reason");; '
              '*) hepta_codec_kind=unrecognized_rejection_reason;; esac; fi; fi;; esac; ')
    shell += ('printf ' + shlex.quote(template) + ' "$hepta_codec_rc" "$hepta_codec_bytes" '
              '"$hepta_codec_kind" "$hepta_codec_reason_json"; ')
    return shell

class PhoneTools:
    def __init__(self, run_dir, atomic_record):
        self.run_dir, self.atomic_record = Path(run_dir), atomic_record
        self.binding = None
        self.calls, self.images = {}, {}
        self.encoded_bytes_used = 0
        self.latest = None
        self.round = 0
        self.verified_facts = {}
        self.last_result_call_id = None
        self.visual_read_constraints = []

    def bind(self, identity):
        require(self.binding is None, 'phone tool turn binding already exists')
        self.binding = dict(identity)

    def invalidate(self):
        self.latest = None

    def _token(self, call_id):
        require(self.binding and isinstance(call_id, str) and SAFE_CALL.fullmatch(call_id),
                'phone semantic tool requires a safe unique call ID and accepted turn')
        require(call_id not in self.calls, 'phone semantic call is already mapped; no redispatch')
        return sha(json.dumps([self.binding, call_id], sort_keys=True,
                              separators=(',', ':')).encode())[:32]

    def _serial_guard(self):
        return '[ "$(getprop ro.serialno)" = ' + shlex.quote(SERIAL) + ' ] || exit 64; '

    def _wire_call(self, call_id, shell):
        return native_bound_call(
            {'call_id': call_id, 'tool': 'adb.exec', 'argv': ['-s', SERIAL, 'shell', shell]},
            self.binding)

    def dispatch_call(self, call):
        require(isinstance(call, dict) and type(call.get('call_id')) is str,
                'native dispatch lacks a call identity')
        record = self.calls.get(call['call_id'])
        if record is None:
            return call
        require(record['turn'] == self.binding,
                'native dispatch belongs to a different accepted turn')
        bound = native_bound_call(record['wire_call'], self.binding)
        base = {key: value for key, value in bound.items()
                if key not in {'config_generation', 'request_sha256', 'binding_fingerprint'}}
        require(call == bound or call == base,
                'native dispatch differs from its complete trusted mapping')
        return bound

    def map(self, decision):
        call_id, tool = decision['call_id'], decision['tool']
        token = self._token(call_id)
        args, command = decision['argv'], decision['command']
        record = {'semantic_tool': tool, 'call_id': call_id, 'capture_id': token,
                  'turn': self.binding, 'state': 'model_decision_mapped_not_dispatch_confirmation'}
        if tool == 'phone.screenshot':
            require(command == '' and args == ['0'], 'screenshot requires empty command and argv[0]')
            require(SHA256.fullmatch(SCREEN_JAR_SHA256), 'screenshot codec artifact not qualified')
            budget = min(MAX_IMAGE_BYTES, MAX_TURN_IMAGE_BYTES - self.encoded_bytes_used)
            require(budget >= MIN_IMAGE_BUDGET, 'turn screenshot byte budget exhausted; no capture dispatched')
            path = '/data/local/tmp/hepta-shot-' + token + '.png'
            shell = self._serial_guard() + 'umask 077; '
            shell += '[ "$(sha256sum ' + shlex.quote(SCREEN_JAR) + " | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = " + shlex.quote(SCREEN_JAR_SHA256) + ' ] || exit 65; '
            shell += 'test ! -e ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' && test ! -L ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' || exit 66; '
            cleanup = 'hepta_capture_rc=$?; trap - 0; rm -f -- ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' || exit 69; exit "$hepta_capture_rc"'
            shell += 'trap ' + shlex.quote(cleanup) + ' 0; '
            shell += page_capture('hepta_page_before')
            shell += "hepta_vp_before=$(dumpsys display | grep 'mViewports='); "
            shell += 'screencap -d ' + PHYSICAL_DISPLAY + ' -p ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' || exit 67; '
            shell += "hepta_vp_after=$(dumpsys display | grep 'mViewports='); "
            shell += page_capture('hepta_page_after')
            shell += b64_variable('hepta_page_before', 'hepta_page_before_b64')
            shell += b64_variable('hepta_page_after', 'hepta_page_after_b64')
            shell += "hepta_before_b64=$(printf '%s' \"$hepta_vp_before\" | base64 | tr -d '\\r\\n'); "
            shell += "hepta_after_b64=$(printf '%s' \"$hepta_vp_after\" | base64 | tr -d '\\r\\n'); "
            argv = ['encode', '--capture-id', token, '--input', path, '--serial', SERIAL,
                    '--viewport-before-b64', '$hepta_before_b64', '--viewport-after-b64', '$hepta_after_b64',
                    '--max-bytes', str(budget)]
            quoted = [('\"' + value + '\"') if value.startswith('$hepta_') else shlex.quote(value) for value in argv]
            shell += 'if hepta_codec=$(CLASSPATH=' + shlex.quote(SCREEN_JAR) + ' app_process /system/bin org.trillionnium.hepta.screen.ScreenshotCodec ' + ' '.join(quoted) + '); then :; else hepta_codec_rc=$?; '
            shell += codec_failure_diagnostic(token) + 'exit 72; fi; '
            template = '{"schema":"hepta.capture-page-envelope.v149.1","capture_id":"' + token + '","page_before_b64":"%s","page_after_b64":"%s","screenshot":%s}\n'
            shell += 'printf ' + shlex.quote(template) + ' "$hepta_page_before_b64" "$hepta_page_after_b64" "$hepta_codec"'
            record.update(max_image_bytes=budget, source_png_path=path)
            self.invalidate()
        elif tool in {'phone.input_text', 'phone.focus_input_text'}:
            require(len(args) == 3 and PACKAGE.fullmatch(args[0]) and VIEW_ID.fullmatch(args[1]),
                    'input_text requires package, exact view-id and observed current text')
            focus_intent = tool == 'phone.focus_input_text'
            jar, jar_sha = (FOCUS_INPUT_JAR, FOCUS_INPUT_JAR_SHA256) if focus_intent else (INPUT_JAR, INPUT_JAR_SHA256)
            require(SHA256.fullmatch(jar_sha), 'Unicode helper artifact not qualified')
            expected, replacement = b64_text(args[2]), b64_text(command)
            helper = ['focus-set-text' if focus_intent else 'set-text', '--operation-id', call_id,
                      '--display', '0', '--package', args[0], '--view-id', args[1],
                      '--expected-text-b64', expected, '--text-b64', replacement]
            precondition = ''
            if focus_intent:
                require(callable(getattr(self, '_focus_input_precondition', None)),
                        'focus input requires the qualified phone-local viewport guard')
                precondition = self._focus_input_precondition()
            shell = self._serial_guard() + precondition
            shell += '[ "$(sha256sum ' + shlex.quote(jar) + " | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = " + shlex.quote(jar_sha) + ' ] || exit 65; '
            helper_class = 'FocusedUnicodeInput' if focus_intent else 'UnicodeInput'
            shell += 'CLASSPATH=' + shlex.quote(jar) + ' app_process /system/bin org.trillionnium.hepta.input.' + helper_class + ' ' + ' '.join(shlex.quote(value) for value in helper)
            record.update(package=args[0], view_id=args[1], expected_text=args[2], requested_text=command,
                          requested_utf8_sha256=sha(command.encode()))
            if focus_intent:
                record.update(input_contract='hepta.focused-unicode-input.v2', helper_sha256=jar_sha,
                              helper_path=jar, focus_then_replace_one_user_intent=True)
            self.invalidate()
        elif tool == 'phone.tap':
            require(command == '' and len(args) == 3 and self.latest
                    and self.latest['call_id'] == args[0] and self.latest['attached_round'] == self.round,
                    'phone.tap requires the current completion\'s latest valid screenshot')
            require(time.monotonic() - self.latest['received_monotonic'] <= 120,
                    'phone.tap screenshot expired; no input dispatched')
            require(all(isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]{0,4}', v) for v in args[1:]),
                    'phone.tap coordinates must be canonical nonnegative integers')
            x, y = map(int, args[1:]); width, height = self.latest['encoded_size']
            require(0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height, 'phone.tap point is outside the attached image')
            original_x = (2 * x * ORIGINAL_SIZE[0] + width) // (2 * width)
            original_y = (2 * y * ORIGINAL_SIZE[1] + height) // (2 * height)
            require(0 <= original_x < ORIGINAL_SIZE[0] and 0 <= original_y < ORIGINAL_SIZE[1],
                    'phone.tap mapped coordinate is outside the original display')
            shell = self._serial_guard() + '[ "$(dumpsys display | grep \'mViewports=\')" = ' + shlex.quote(self.latest['viewport']) + ' ] || exit 68; '
            shell += page_equality_guard(self.latest['page_state'])
            guard_path = '/data/local/tmp/hepta-tap-guard-' + token + '.png'
            shell += 'umask 077; test ! -e ' + shlex.quote(guard_path) + ' && test ! -L ' + shlex.quote(guard_path) + ' || exit 66; '
            cleanup = 'hepta_guard_rc=$?; trap - 0; rm -f -- ' + shlex.quote(guard_path) + ' || exit 69; exit "$hepta_guard_rc"'
            shell += 'trap ' + shlex.quote(cleanup) + ' 0; '
            shell += 'screencap -d ' + PHYSICAL_DISPLAY + ' -p ' + shlex.quote(guard_path) + ' || exit 67; '
            shell += '[ "$(sha256sum ' + shlex.quote(guard_path) + " | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = " + shlex.quote(self.latest['source_png_sha256']) + ' ] || exit 71; '
            shell += page_equality_guard(self.latest['page_state'])
            shell += '[ "$(dumpsys display | grep \'mViewports=\')" = ' + shlex.quote(self.latest['viewport']) + ' ] || exit 68; '
            shell += 'input -d 0 tap ' + str(original_x) + ' ' + str(original_y)
            record.update(source_image_call_id=args[0], source_image_sha256=self.latest['image_sha256'],
                          encoded_xy=[x, y], original_xy=[original_x, original_y],
                          page_state_sha256=self.latest['page_state_sha256'],
                          source_png_sha256=self.latest['source_png_sha256'],
                          exact_pixel_and_focus_guard=True, guard_png_path=guard_path,
                          package=self.latest['observed_page']['component'].split('/')[0])
            self.invalidate()
        elif tool == 'phone.read_text':
            require(command == '' and 2 <= len(args) <= 6 and PACKAGE.fullmatch(args[0])
                    and len(set(args[1:])) == len(args[1:]) and all(VIEW_ID.fullmatch(v) for v in args[1:]),
                    'read_text requires package and one to five unique exact public view IDs')
            for condition in self.visual_read_constraints:
                if args[0] == condition['package'] and condition['challenge_view_id'] in args[1:]:
                    require(any(fact['kind'] == 'visual_tap_executed' and fact['package'] == args[0]
                                for fact in self.verified_facts.values()),
                            'visual challenge readback requires a completed screenshot-bound visual tap first')
            xml_path = '/data/local/tmp/hepta-public-read-' + token + '.xml'
            shell = public_text_command(self._serial_guard(), token, args[0], xml_path)
            record.update(package=args[0], view_ids=args[1:], source_xml_path=xml_path)
            self.invalidate()
        elif tool == 'phone.read_text_anchor':
            require(command == '' and len(args) == 4 and PACKAGE.fullmatch(args[0])
                    and VIEW_ID.fullmatch(args[1]) and VIEW_ID.fullmatch(args[3])
                    and args[1] != args[3] and 0 < len(args[2].encode()) <= 256 and '\0' not in args[2],
                    'read_text_anchor requires package, title view-id, exact title and summary view-id')
            for condition in self.visual_read_constraints:
                if args[0] == condition['package']:
                    require(any(fact['kind'] == 'visual_tap_executed' and fact['package'] == args[0]
                                for fact in self.verified_facts.values()),
                            'anchored public read requires prior visual selection for this challenge')
            xml_path = '/data/local/tmp/hepta-public-anchor-' + token + '.xml'
            shell = public_text_command(self._serial_guard(), token, args[0], xml_path)
            record.update(package=args[0], title_view_id=args[1], anchor_text=args[2], value_view_id=args[3],
                          source_xml_path=xml_path, selector_schema='hepta.public-text-anchor.v150.1')
            self.invalidate()
        elif tool == 'phone.return_hepta':
            require(command == '' and args == [], 'return_hepta requires empty command and argv')
            shell = return_command(self._serial_guard(), token)
            record.update(postcondition='actual_inner_display_focused_resumed_HEPTA')
            self.invalidate()
        else:
            raise ProviderError('unrecognized phone semantic tool')
        wire = self._wire_call(call_id, shell)
        record['wire_tool'] = wire['tool']
        record['wire_call'] = wire
        self.atomic_record(self.run_dir / ('semantic-' + sha(call_id.encode()) + '.json'), record)
        self.calls[call_id] = record
        return wire['argv']

    def _image(self, reply, source_content, call):
        call_id = call['call_id']; source_hash = sha(source_content.encode())
        if call_id in self.images:
            old = self.images[call_id]
            require(old['original_result_sha256'] == source_hash
                    and sha(self._read_image(Path(old['path']))) == old['image_sha256'],
                    'retained screenshot observation changed')
            return old
        raw = native_streams(reply, call_id, call.get('wire_tool', 'adb.exec'), expected_call=call['wire_call'], expected_scope=call['turn'])
        require(len(raw) <= 600000, 'screenshot JSON exceeds its transport bound')
        envelope = strict_json(raw)
        require(set(envelope) == {'schema', 'capture_id', 'page_before_b64', 'page_after_b64', 'screenshot'}
                and envelope['schema'] == 'hepta.capture-page-envelope.v149.1'
                and envelope['capture_id'] == call['capture_id'], 'screenshot page envelope differs')
        page_before = decode_text(envelope['page_before_b64'], 'page before capture')
        page_after = decode_text(envelope['page_after_b64'], 'page after capture')
        require(page_before == page_after, 'page focus changed during screenshot capture')
        observed_page = page_state(page_before)
        value = envelope['screenshot']
        require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == SCREEN_FIELDS
                and value.get('schema') == 'hepta.phone-screenshot.v1' and value.get('status') == 'encoded'
                and value.get('capture_id') == call['capture_id'] and value.get('serial') == SERIAL
                and type(value.get('logical_display_id')) is int and value['logical_display_id'] == 0
                and type(value.get('rotation')) is int and value['rotation'] == 0
                and isinstance(value.get('physical_display_id'), str)
                and value.get('physical_display_id') in {PHYSICAL_DISPLAY, 'local:' + PHYSICAL_DISPLAY},
                'screenshot metadata does not match the selected phone call')
        before, after = value.get('viewport_before'), value.get('viewport_after')
        require(before == after, 'screenshot display changed during capture')
        viewport_sha = validate_viewport(before)
        require((value.get('original_width'), value.get('original_height')) == ORIGINAL_SIZE
                and value.get('media_type') == 'image/jpeg' and value.get('encoding') == 'base64'
                and type(value.get('quality')) is int and 1 <= value['quality'] <= 100
                and isinstance(value.get('data_base64'), str), 'screenshot codec fields differ')
        try: image = base64.b64decode(value['data_base64'], validate=True)
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as error: raise ProviderError('screenshot JPEG base64 is invalid') from error
        require(base64.b64encode(image).decode() == value['data_base64']
                and type(value.get('encoded_bytes')) is int and value['encoded_bytes'] == len(image)
                and len(image) <= call['max_image_bytes'] and value.get('image_sha256') == sha(image)
                and isinstance(value.get('source_png_sha256'), str) and SHA256.fullmatch(value['source_png_sha256'])
                and type(value.get('source_png_bytes')) is int and 0 < value['source_png_bytes'] <= 16*1024*1024,
                'screenshot bytes or provenance hash differs')
        size = jpeg_size(image)
        require(size == (value.get('encoded_width'), value.get('encoded_height')),
                'screenshot JPEG SOF dimensions differ from codec metadata')
        require(abs(size[0] * ORIGINAL_SIZE[1] - size[1] * ORIGINAL_SIZE[0]) <= max(ORIGINAL_SIZE),
                'screenshot encoding changed the display aspect ratio')
        require(self.encoded_bytes_used + len(image) <= MAX_TURN_IMAGE_BYTES,
                'turn screenshot budget exceeded')
        path = self.run_dir / ('image-' + call['capture_id'] + '.jpg')
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(image); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        self.encoded_bytes_used += len(image)
        result = {k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != 'data_base64'}
        result.update(path=str(path), call_id=call_id, turn=self.binding,
                      original_result_sha256=source_hash, viewport_sha256=viewport_sha,
                      encoded_size=list(size), viewport=before, received_monotonic=time.monotonic(),
                      page_state=page_before, page_state_sha256=sha(page_before.encode()),
                      observed_page=observed_page,
                      observation_kind='lossy_scaled_actual_phone_screenshot_not_UI_XML',
                      pixel_mapping='round_half_up(encoded_coordinate*original_dimension/encoded_dimension)',
                      turn_image_bytes_used=self.encoded_bytes_used)
        self.atomic_record(self.run_dir / ('capture-' + call['capture_id'] + '.json'), result)
        self.images[call_id] = result
        if observed_page['component'] == HEPTA_FULL_COMPONENT:
            self.verified_facts[call_id] = {'kind': 'foreground_hepta', 'call_id': call_id,
                'original_result_sha256': source_hash, 'component': observed_page['component'],
                'display_id': 0, 'evidence_type': 'screenshot_page_focus'}
        return result

    def _read_image(self, path):
        require(path.parent == self.run_dir, 'image path left the current run directory')
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            info = os.fstat(fd)
            require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid == os.getuid()
                    and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_nlink == 1
                    and 0 < info.st_size <= MAX_IMAGE_BYTES, 'retained image ownership or size changed')
            raw = bytearray()
            while len(raw) <= MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
                chunk = os.read(fd, min(65536, MAX_IMAGE_BYTES + 1 - len(raw)))
                if not chunk:
                    break
                raw.extend(chunk)
            require(len(raw) == info.st_size, 'retained image changed while read')
            return bytes(raw)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)

    def prepare(self, messages, rendered, round_number):
        require(len(messages) == len(rendered), 'model transcript projection count differs')
        self.round = round_number
        self.latest = None
        self.last_result_call_id = next((m.get('tool_call_id') for m in reversed(messages)
                                        if m.get('role') == 'tool'), None)
        output, attached = [], []
        for index, (original, projected) in enumerate(zip(messages, rendered)):
            if original.get('role') != 'tool' or original.get('tool_call_id') not in self.calls:
                output.append(projected); continue
            call_id = original['tool_call_id']; call = self.calls[call_id]
            reply = strict_json(projected['content'])
            if call['semantic_tool'] == 'phone.screenshot':
                actual = strict_json(original['content']); image = self._image(actual, original['content'], call)
                fresh = index == len(messages) - 1
                public = {key: value for key, value in image.items()
                          if key not in {'path', 'received_monotonic', 'viewport', 'page_state'}}
                public.update(image_attached_in_this_completion=fresh, stale_for_actions=not fresh)
                reply['_hepta_image_observation'] = public
                # This is a derived model view, not a changed wire/native record.
                for record in reply.get('events', []):
                    event = record.get('event', {})
                    if event.get('kind') == 'output':
                        raw = base64.b64decode(event['data'], validate=True)
                        record['event'] = {'kind': 'output_reference', 'stream': event['stream'],
                                           'original_encoding': 'base64', 'byte_count': len(raw),
                                           'sha256': sha(raw), 'original_data_retained_in_wire_evidence': True}
                decoded = reply.get('_hepta_decoded_output', {})
                for stream in decoded.get('streams', []):
                    if stream.get('stream') == 'stdout':
                        stream.pop('text', None)
                        stream['render_status'] = 'image_codec_JSON_referenced_actual_JPEG_attached_when_fresh'
                if fresh:
                    self.latest = dict(image, attached_round=round_number)
                    attached.append(image)
            elif call['semantic_tool'] == 'phone.focus_input_text':
                actual = strict_json(original['content'])
                value = strict_json(native_streams(actual, call_id, call.get('wire_tool', 'adb.exec'), expected_call=call['wire_call'], expected_scope=call['turn']))
                readback = verify_focus_input(value, call_id, call['package'], call['view_id'],
                                              call['expected_text'], call['requested_text'])
                reply['_hepta_verified_text_input'] = {'call_id': call_id, 'package': call['package'],
                    'view_id': call['view_id'], 'actual_readback_utf8': readback.decode(),
                    'actual_utf8_sha256': sha(readback), 'status': value['status'],
                    'input_contract': 'hepta.focused-unicode-input.v2',
                    'focus_verified': True, 'focus_action_attempted': value['focus_action_attempted'],
                    'own_automation_disconnected': True, 'original_wire_evidence_unchanged': True}
                self.verified_facts[call_id] = {'kind': 'text_readback_exact', 'call_id': call_id,
                    'package': call['package'], 'view_id': call['view_id'], 'utf8_sha256': sha(readback),
                    'original_result_sha256': sha(original['content'].encode()),
                    'input_contract': 'hepta.focused-unicode-input.v2', 'focus_verified': True,
                    'evidence_type': 'native_focus_then_unicode_exact_readback'}
            elif call['semantic_tool'] == 'phone.input_text':
                actual = strict_json(original['content']); raw = native_streams(actual, call_id, call.get('wire_tool', 'adb.exec'), expected_call=call['wire_call'], expected_scope=call['turn']); value = strict_json(raw)
                expected = call['requested_text'].encode()
                require(value.get('schema') == 'hepta.focused-unicode-input.v1'
                        and value.get('status') in {'set_verified', 'already_exact'}
                        and value.get('operation_id') == call_id and value.get('display_id') == 0
                        and value.get('package') == call['package'] and value.get('view_id') == call['view_id']
                        and value.get('requested_utf8_sha256') == sha(expected)
                        and value.get('before_utf8_sha256') == sha(call['expected_text'].encode())
                        and value.get('after_utf8_sha256') == sha(expected)
                        and value.get('own_automation_disconnected') is True,
                        'Unicode helper did not verify the exact requested field text and cleanup')
                if value['status'] == 'set_verified':
                    require(value.get('action_attempted') is True
                            and value.get('effect_state') == 'observed_exact_requested_text',
                            'Unicode changed-text status is inconsistent')
                else:
                    require(value.get('action_attempted') is False and value.get('effect_state') == 'not_started',
                            'Unicode already-exact status is inconsistent')
                require(isinstance(value.get('readback_text_b64'), str), 'Unicode readback field is absent')
                try: readback = base64.b64decode(value['readback_text_b64'], validate=True)
                except (ValueError, TypeError) as error: raise ProviderError('Unicode readback encoding differs') from error
                require(readback == expected and base64.b64encode(readback).decode() == value['readback_text_b64'],
                        'Unicode helper readback differs from requested text or is noncanonical')
                reply['_hepta_verified_text_input'] = {'call_id': call_id, 'package': call['package'],
                    'view_id': call['view_id'], 'actual_readback_utf8': readback.decode(),
                    'actual_utf8_sha256': sha(readback), 'status': value['status'],
                    'own_automation_disconnected': True, 'original_wire_evidence_unchanged': True}
                self.verified_facts[call_id] = {'kind': 'text_readback_exact', 'call_id': call_id,
                    'package': call['package'], 'view_id': call['view_id'], 'utf8_sha256': sha(readback),
                    'original_result_sha256': sha(original['content'].encode()),
                    'evidence_type': 'focused_unicode_helper_exact_readback'}
            elif call['semantic_tool'] == 'phone.tap':
                actual = strict_json(original['content'])
                raw = native_streams(actual, call_id, call.get('wire_tool', 'adb.exec'), expected_call=call['wire_call'], expected_scope=call['turn'])
                require(raw == b'', 'qualified tap produced unexpected output')
                self.verified_facts[call_id] = {'kind': 'visual_tap_executed', 'call_id': call_id,
                    'package': call['package'], 'source_image_call_id': call['source_image_call_id'],
                    'source_image_sha256': call['source_image_sha256'],
                    'original_result_sha256': sha(original['content'].encode()),
                    'exact_pixel_and_focus_guard': True}
            elif call['semantic_tool'] == 'phone.read_text':
                actual = strict_json(original['content'])
                raw = native_streams(actual, call_id, call.get('wire_tool', 'adb.exec'), expected_call=call['wire_call'], expected_scope=call['turn'])
                require(len(raw) <= 400000, 'public text receipt exceeds transport bound')
                observation, viewport = verify_public_text(strict_json(raw), call['capture_id'],
                                                            call['package'], call['view_ids'])
                validate_viewport(viewport)
                fact = {'kind': 'public_text_observation', 'call_id': call_id,
                        'original_result_sha256': sha(original['content'].encode()),
                        **observation, 'evidence_type': 'focused_public_UI_XML_unique_view_readback'}
                self.verified_facts[call_id] = fact
                reply['_hepta_verified_public_text'] = fact
            elif call['semantic_tool'] == 'phone.read_text_anchor':
                actual = strict_json(original['content'])
                raw = native_streams(actual, call_id, call.get('wire_tool', 'adb.exec'), expected_call=call['wire_call'], expected_scope=call['turn'])
                require(len(raw) <= 400000, 'public anchor receipt exceeds transport bound')
                observation, viewport = verify_public_text_anchor(strict_json(raw), call['capture_id'],
                    call['package'], call['title_view_id'], call['anchor_text'], call['value_view_id'])
                validate_viewport(viewport)
                fact = {'kind': 'public_text_anchor_observation', 'call_id': call_id,
                        'original_result_sha256': sha(original['content'].encode()),
                        **observation, 'evidence_type': 'focused_public_UI_same_preference_row_anchor'}
                self.verified_facts[call_id] = fact
                reply['_hepta_verified_public_anchor'] = fact
            elif call['semantic_tool'] == 'phone.return_hepta':
                actual = strict_json(original['content'])
                value = strict_json(native_streams(actual, call_id, call.get('wire_tool', 'adb.exec'), expected_call=call['wire_call'], expected_scope=call['turn']))
                observed, viewport = verify_return(value, call['capture_id'])
                validate_viewport(viewport)
                fact = {'kind': 'foreground_hepta', 'call_id': call_id,
                        'original_result_sha256': sha(original['content'].encode()),
                        'component': observed['component'], 'display_id': 0,
                        'evidence_type': 'explicit_return_launch_and_actual_focus'}
                self.verified_facts[call_id] = fact
                reply['_hepta_verified_return'] = fact
            output.append({**projected, 'content': json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))})
        self.atomic_record(self.run_dir / f'codex-{round_number:02d}.images.json',
                           {'turn': self.binding, 'images': [{k: v for k, v in image.items() if k != 'received_monotonic'} for image in attached],
                            'direct_host_tools_enabled': False, 'old_images_attached': False})
        return output, [image['path'] for image in attached]

"""Pure mappings and parsers for qualified inner-display page/return receipts.

This module executes no phone command. Guard failures precede input; a launch
return code alone cannot establish the HEPTA foreground postcondition.
"""
import base64
import hashlib
import re
import shlex
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from provider_openai_compatible import ProviderError

HEPTA_COMPONENT = 'org.trillionnium.owneropen/.OwnerOpenShellActivity'
HEPTA_FULL_COMPONENT = 'org.trillionnium.owneropen/org.trillionnium.owneropen.OwnerOpenShellActivity'
PAGE_STATE_COMMAND = (
    "dumpsys window | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(Display: mDisplayId=|mTopFocusedDisplayId=|mCurrentFocus=|mFocusedApp=|isKeyguardShowing=)'; "
    "dumpsys activity activities | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*topResumedActivity='"
)


def require(ok, reason):
    if not ok:
        raise ProviderError('[phone_postcondition] ' + reason)


def decode_text(value, label, maximum=16384):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and 0 < len(value) <= maximum * 2, label + ' encoding missing or oversized')
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(value, validate=True)
        text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as error:
        raise ProviderError('[phone_postcondition] ' + label + ' is not canonical UTF8/base64') from error
    require(base64.b64encode(raw).decode() == value and 0 < len(raw) <= maximum and '\0' not in text,
            label + ' bound or canonical encoding differs')
    return text


def component(text):
    values = re.findall(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.$/])([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.$]*/[A-Za-z0-9_.$]+)(?![A-Za-z0-9_.$/])', text)
    require(len(values) == 1, 'foreground component is missing or ambiguous')
    package, activity = values[0].split('/')
    if activity.startswith('.'):
        activity = package + activity
    return package + '/' + activity


def page_state(text):
    require(isinstance(text, str) and 0 < len(text.encode()) <= 16384 and '\0' not in text,
            'page state is missing or oversized')
    sections, top_ids, resumed = {}, [], []
    current = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Display: mDisplayId=([0-9]+)(?:\s+.*)?', line)
        if match:
            current = int(match.group(1))
            require(current not in sections, 'duplicate display section')
            sections[current] = {}
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'mTopFocusedDisplayId=([0-9]+)', line)
        if match:
            top_ids.append(int(match.group(1)))
            continue
        if line.startswith('topResumedActivity='):
            resumed.append(line.split('=', 1)[1])
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'(mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp|isKeyguardShowing)=(.*)', line)
        require(match is not None and current in sections, 'page state line is outside a qualified display section')
        key, value = match.groups()
        require(key not in sections[current], 'duplicate display focus field')
        sections[current][key] = value
    require(top_ids == [0] and 0 in sections, 'top focused display is not the qualified inner display')
    active = sections[0]
    require(set(active) == {'mCurrentFocus', 'mFocusedApp', 'isKeyguardShowing'}
            and active['isKeyguardShowing'] == 'false', 'inner display focus or unlocked state is unconfirmed')
    require(active['mCurrentFocus'].startswith('Window{') and active['mFocusedApp'].startswith('ActivityRecord{'),
            'inner display focus is null or not an app window')
    require(len(resumed) == 1 and resumed[0].startswith('ActivityRecord{'), 'resumed activity is missing or ambiguous')
    actual = component(active['mCurrentFocus'])
    require(component(active['mFocusedApp']) == actual and component(resumed[0]) == actual,
            'focused window, focused app and resumed activity disagree')
    return {'display_id': 0, 'component': actual, 'keyguard_showing': False}


def page_capture(variable):
    return variable + '=$(' + PAGE_STATE_COMMAND + '); '


def b64_variable(source, target):
    return target + "=$(printf '%s' \"$" + source + "\" | base64 | tr -d '\\r\\n'); "


def page_equality_guard(expected):
    return page_capture('hepta_page_now') + '[ "$hepta_page_now" = ' + shlex.quote(expected) + ' ] || exit 70; '


def return_command(serial_guard, token):
    # Capture am's exit code immediately. All observations are read-only and
    # cannot replace a failed launch status with the last printf/grep status.
    shell = serial_guard + 'hepta_launch=$(am start -W -n ' + shlex.quote(HEPTA_COMPONENT) + ' 2>&1); hepta_launch_rc=$?; '
    shell += page_capture('hepta_return_page')
    shell += "hepta_return_viewport=$(dumpsys display | grep 'mViewports='); "
    for source, target in [('hepta_launch', 'hepta_launch_b64'), ('hepta_return_page', 'hepta_page_b64'),
                           ('hepta_return_viewport', 'hepta_viewport_b64')]:
        shell += b64_variable(source, target)
    template = '{"schema":"hepta.return-receipt.v149.1","operation_id":"' + token + '","launch_exit_code":%s,"launch_b64":"%s","page_b64":"%s","viewport_b64":"%s"}\n'
    shell += 'printf ' + shlex.quote(template) + ' "$hepta_launch_rc" "$hepta_launch_b64" "$hepta_page_b64" "$hepta_viewport_b64"; exit "$hepta_launch_rc"'
    return shell


def verify_return(value, token):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {'schema', 'operation_id', 'launch_exit_code', 'launch_b64', 'page_b64', 'viewport_b64'}
            and value['schema'] == 'hepta.return-receipt.v149.1' and value['operation_id'] == token
            and type(value['launch_exit_code']) is int and value['launch_exit_code'] == 0,
            'return receipt identity or launch exit status differs')
    launch = decode_text(value['launch_b64'], 'launch receipt', 8192)
    require(re.findall(r'^Status:\s*(\S+)\s*$', launch, re.MULTILINE) == ['ok']
            and not re.search(r'^\s*(?:Error|Exception|SecurityException)\b', launch, re.MULTILINE),
            'activity launch did not report one successful status')
    activities = re.findall(r'^Activity:\s*(\S+)\s*$', launch, re.MULTILINE)
    require(len(activities) == 1 and component(activities[0]) == HEPTA_FULL_COMPONENT,
            'activity launch reported a different target')
    page = decode_text(value['page_b64'], 'return page')
    observed = page_state(page)
    require(observed['component'] == HEPTA_FULL_COMPONENT, 'HEPTA is not the actual focused and resumed activity')
    return observed, decode_text(value['viewport_b64'], 'return viewport')


def public_text_command(serial_guard, token, package, path):
    shell = serial_guard + 'umask 077; test ! -e ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' && test ! -L ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' || exit 66; '
    cleanup = 'hepta_read_rc=$?; trap - 0; rm -f -- ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' || exit 69; exit "$hepta_read_rc"'
    shell += 'trap ' + shlex.quote(cleanup) + ' 0; '
    shell += page_capture('hepta_page_before')
    shell += "hepta_vp_before=$(dumpsys display | grep 'mViewports='); "
    shell += 'hepta_dump=$(uiautomator dump ' + shlex.quote(path) + ' 2>&1) || { printf \'%s\\n\' "$hepta_dump" >&2; exit 73; }; '
    shell += '[ "$(wc -c < ' + shlex.quote(path) + ')" -le 196608 ] || exit 74; '
    shell += "hepta_vp_after=$(dumpsys display | grep 'mViewports='); "
    shell += page_capture('hepta_page_after')
    for source, target in [('hepta_page_before', 'hepta_page_before_b64'), ('hepta_page_after', 'hepta_page_after_b64'),
                           ('hepta_vp_before', 'hepta_vp_before_b64'), ('hepta_vp_after', 'hepta_vp_after_b64')]:
        shell += b64_variable(source, target)
    shell += 'hepta_xml_b64=$(base64 < ' + shlex.quote(path) + " | tr -d '\\r\\n'); "
    template = ('{"schema":"hepta.public-text-receipt.v149.1","operation_id":"' + token + '","package":"' + package
                + '","page_before_b64":"%s","page_after_b64":"%s","viewport_before_b64":"%s","viewport_after_b64":"%s","xml_b64":"%s"}\n')
    shell += 'printf ' + shlex.quote(template) + ' "$hepta_page_before_b64" "$hepta_page_after_b64" "$hepta_vp_before_b64" "$hepta_vp_after_b64" "$hepta_xml_b64"'
    return shell


def verify_public_text(value, token, package, view_ids):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {'schema', 'operation_id', 'package', 'page_before_b64',
            'page_after_b64', 'viewport_before_b64', 'viewport_after_b64', 'xml_b64'}
            and value['schema'] == 'hepta.public-text-receipt.v149.1'
            and value['operation_id'] == token and value['package'] == package,
            'public text receipt identity differs')
    before = decode_text(value['page_before_b64'], 'public text page before')
    after = decode_text(value['page_after_b64'], 'public text page after')
    require(before == after, 'public text page focus changed during observation')
    observed = page_state(before)
    require(observed['component'].split('/')[0] == package, 'public text target is not the focused package')
    viewport_before = decode_text(value['viewport_before_b64'], 'public text viewport before')
    viewport_after = decode_text(value['viewport_after_b64'], 'public text viewport after')
    require(viewport_before == viewport_after, 'public text display changed during observation')
    xml = decode_text(value['xml_b64'], 'public UI hierarchy', 196608)
    require('<!DOCTYPE' not in xml and '<!ENTITY' not in xml, 'public UI XML declarations are forbidden')
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    except ET.ParseError as error:
        raise ProviderError('[phone_postcondition] public UI XML is malformed') from error
    require(root.tag == 'hierarchy' and root.get('rotation') == '0', 'public UI root or rotation differs')
    nodes = list(root.iter())
    require(len(nodes) <= 4096 and all(node.tag in {'hierarchy', 'node'} for node in nodes), 'public UI node bound or type differs')
    values = []
    for view_id in view_ids:
        matches = [node for node in nodes if node.get('resource-id') == view_id]
        require(len(matches) == 1, 'public view is missing or ambiguous: ' + view_id)
        node = matches[0]
        require(node.get('package') == package and node.get('password') == 'false'
                and node.get('enabled') == 'true' and node.get('visible-to-user', 'true') == 'true',
                'public view package, password, visibility or enabled state differs')
        bounds = re.fullmatch(r'\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]', node.get('bounds', ''))
        require(bounds is not None, 'public view bounds are missing')
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, bounds.groups())
        require(0 <= x1 < x2 <= 1224 and 0 <= y1 < y2 <= 2992, 'public view bounds leave the qualified screen')
        text = node.get('text')
        require(isinstance(text, str) and '\0' not in text and len(text.encode()) <= 4096, 'public view text is absent or oversized')
        values.append({'view_id': view_id, 'text': text, 'utf8_sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                       'bounds': [x1, y1, x2, y2]})
    return {'package': package, 'component': observed['component'], 'display_id': 0,
            'xml_sha256': hashlib.sha256(xml.encode()).hexdigest(), 'values': values}, viewport_before


# v150-r9: opening an app means bringing its approved component to the top.
# One activity start is followed only by bounded observations. No retrying effect.
APP_OPEN_FLAGS = "NEW_TASK|CLEAR_TOP"
APP_OPEN_MAX_OBSERVATIONS = 20

def stable_activity_observation(target):
    full = component(target)
    package, activity = full.split("/")
    short = package + "/." + activity[len(package) + 1:] if activity.startswith(package + ".") else full
    variants = "(" + "|".join(re.escape(x) for x in sorted({full, short})) + ")"
    suffix = variants + r"([[:space:]}]|$)"
    shell = "hepta_open_attempts=0; hepta_open_stable=false; hepta_open_previous=''; hepta_open_previous_vp=''; "
    shell += "hepta_open_page=''; hepta_open_viewport=''; "
    shell += 'if [ "$hepta_launch_rc" -eq 0 ]; then '
    shell += 'while [ "$hepta_open_attempts" -lt ' + str(APP_OPEN_MAX_OBSERVATIONS) + ' ]; do '
    shell += 'hepta_open_attempts=$((hepta_open_attempts + 1)); '
    shell += page_capture("hepta_open_page")
    shell += "hepta_open_viewport=$(dumpsys display | grep 'mViewports='); "
    checks = [
        r"^[[:space:]]*mCurrentFocus=Window\{.*[[:space:]]" + suffix,
        r"^[[:space:]]*mFocusedApp=ActivityRecord\{.*[[:space:]]" + suffix,
        r"^[[:space:]]*topResumedActivity=ActivityRecord\{.*[[:space:]]" + suffix,
        r"^[[:space:]]*mTopFocusedDisplayId=0$",
    ]
    predicate = " && ".join(
        '[ "$(printf \'%s\\n\' "$hepta_open_page" | grep -E -c -- '
        + shlex.quote(pattern) + ')" = 1 ]' for pattern in checks)
    shell += "if " + predicate + '; then '
    shell += 'if [ "$hepta_open_page" = "$hepta_open_previous" ] && [ "$hepta_open_viewport" = "$hepta_open_previous_vp" ]; then '
    shell += 'hepta_open_stable=true; break; fi; '
    shell += 'hepta_open_previous=$hepta_open_page; hepta_open_previous_vp=$hepta_open_viewport; '
    shell += "else hepta_open_previous=''; hepta_open_previous_vp=''; fi; "
    shell += 'if [ "$hepta_open_attempts" -lt ' + str(APP_OPEN_MAX_OBSERVATIONS) + ' ]; then sleep 0.1; fi; '
    shell += "done; fi; "
    return shell

def app_open_command(serial_guard, target, token, precondition=""):
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", token), "open operation token differs")
    component(target)
    shell = serial_guard + precondition
    shell += 'hepta_launch=$(am start --display 0 -f 0x14000000 -W -n ' + shlex.quote(target) + ' 2>&1); hepta_launch_rc=$?; '
    shell += stable_activity_observation(target)
    for source, dest in [("hepta_launch", "hepta_launch_b64"),
                         ("hepta_open_page", "hepta_page_b64"),
                         ("hepta_open_viewport", "hepta_viewport_b64")]:
        shell += b64_variable(source, dest)
    template = ('{"schema":"hepta.local-app-open.v150.2","operation_id":"' + token
                + '","launch_exit_code":%s,"launch_flags":"NEW_TASK|CLEAR_TOP",'
                  '"observation_attempts":%s,"observation_stable":%s,'
                  '"launch_b64":"%s","page_b64":"%s","viewport_b64":"%s"}\n')
    shell += 'printf ' + shlex.quote(template) + ' "$hepta_launch_rc" "$hepta_open_attempts" "$hepta_open_stable" "$hepta_launch_b64" "$hepta_page_b64" "$hepta_viewport_b64"; '
    shell += '[ "$hepta_launch_rc" -eq 0 ] || exit "$hepta_launch_rc"; '
    shell += '[ "$hepta_open_stable" = true ] || exit 77'
    return shell

def verify_app_open(value, token, target):
    names = {"schema", "operation_id", "launch_exit_code", "launch_flags",
             "observation_attempts", "observation_stable", "launch_b64",
             "page_b64", "viewport_b64"}
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == names
            and value["schema"] == "hepta.local-app-open.v150.2"
            and value["operation_id"] == token
            and type(value["launch_exit_code"]) is int and value["launch_exit_code"] == 0
            and value["launch_flags"] == APP_OPEN_FLAGS
            and type(value["observation_attempts"]) is int
            and 2 <= value["observation_attempts"] <= APP_OPEN_MAX_OBSERVATIONS
            and value["observation_stable"] is True, "app open observation identity or stability differs")
    launch = decode_text(value["launch_b64"], "app launch receipt", 8192)
    require(re.findall(r"^Status:\s*(\S+)\s*$", launch, re.MULTILINE) == ["ok"]
            and not re.search(r"^\s*(?:Error|Exception|SecurityException)\b", launch, re.MULTILINE),
            "app launch failed")
    activities = re.findall(r"^Activity:\s*(\S+)\s*$", launch, re.MULTILINE)
    require(len(activities) == 1 and component(activities[0]) == component(target),
            "launch reported another component")
    observed = page_state(decode_text(value["page_b64"], "app foreground"))
    require(observed["component"] == component(target), "launched app is not actual foreground")
    return observed, decode_text(value["viewport_b64"], "app viewport")


def verify_focus_input(value, operation_id, package, view_id, old_text, requested_text):
    """v2 atomically intends one focus then one replacement; no v1 reinterpretation."""
    expected = requested_text.encode()
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('schema') == 'hepta.focused-unicode-input.v2'
            and value.get('operation_id') == operation_id and value.get('display_id') == 0
            and value.get('package') == package and value.get('view_id') == view_id
            and value.get('requested_utf8_sha256') == hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()
            and value.get('before_utf8_sha256') == hashlib.sha256(old_text.encode()).hexdigest()
            and value.get('after_utf8_sha256') == hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()
            and value.get('focus_verified') is True and value.get('text_verified') is True
            and value.get('own_automation_disconnected') is True,
            'focus input identity, exact text, focus or cleanup differs')
    focus = value.get('focus_action_attempted')
    require(type(focus) is bool and value.get('focus_action_accepted') is focus,
            'focus action receipt is inconsistent')
    capabilities = value.get('observed_target_capabilities')
    require(type(value.get('target_match_count')) is int and value['target_match_count'] == 1
            and isinstance(capabilities, list) and len(capabilities) == 1
            and isinstance(capabilities[0], dict)
            and all(capabilities[0].get(key) is True for key in
                    ('visible', 'enabled', 'editable', 'focusable', 'focused'))
            and capabilities[0].get('password') is False
            and isinstance(capabilities[0].get('action_ids'), list)
            and all(type(x) is int for x in capabilities[0]['action_ids'])
            and 2097152 in capabilities[0]['action_ids'],
            'focus input actual unique editor capability differs')
    if value.get('status') == 'set_verified':
        require(value.get('action_attempted') is True and value.get('action_accepted') is True
                and value.get('effect_state') == 'observed_exact_requested_text',
                'focus input changed-text receipt is inconsistent')
    else:
        require(value.get('status') == 'already_exact' and old_text == requested_text
                and value.get('action_attempted') is False and value.get('action_accepted') is False
                and value.get('effect_state') == ('focus_verified_text_already_exact' if focus else 'not_started'),
                'focus input already-exact receipt is inconsistent')
    encoded = value.get('readback_text_b64')
    require(isinstance(encoded, str), 'focus input exact readback absent')
    try:
        readback = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        raise ProviderError('focus input readback is not canonical base64') from error
    require(readback == expected and base64.b64encode(readback).decode() == encoded,
            'focus input original readback bytes differ')
    return readback


def verify_public_text_anchor(value, token, package, title_view_id, anchor_text, value_view_id):
    """Explicit v150.1 selector: unique title and value in one direct Preference text container.

    Android Preference keys are never view IDs. No ancestor search, first-match,
    text normalization or fallback to a different row is performed.
    """
    observed, viewport = verify_public_text(value, token, package, [])
    xml = decode_text(value['xml_b64'], 'public UI hierarchy', 196608)
    root = ET.fromstring(xml)
    require(isinstance(anchor_text, str) and 0 < len(anchor_text.encode()) <= 256
            and '\0' not in anchor_text and title_view_id != value_view_id,
            'public anchor selector is invalid')
    parents = {child: parent for parent in root.iter() for child in parent}
    matches = [node for node in root.iter('node')
               if node.get('resource-id') == title_view_id and node.get('text') == anchor_text]
    require(len(matches) == 1, 'public title anchor is missing or ambiguous')
    title = matches[0]
    row = parents.get(title)
    require(row is not None and row.tag == 'node'
            and row.get('class') == 'android.widget.RelativeLayout',
            'public title is not in a qualified direct Preference text container')
    titles = [node for node in row if node.get('resource-id') == title_view_id]
    values = [node for node in row if node.get('resource-id') == value_view_id]
    require(titles == [title] and len(values) == 1,
            'Preference row title or summary is missing or ambiguous')
    target = values[0]
    def checked_bounds(node):
        require(node.get('package') == package and node.get('password') == 'false'
                and node.get('enabled') == 'true' and node.get('visible-to-user', 'true') == 'true',
                'public anchor node package, privacy, visibility or enabled state differs')
        match = re.fullmatch(r'\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]', node.get('bounds', ''))
        require(match is not None, 'public anchor bounds absent')
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, match.groups())
        require(0 <= x1 < x2 <= 1224 and 0 <= y1 < y2 <= 2992,
                'public anchor node leaves the qualified screen')
        return [x1, y1, x2, y2]
    row_bounds, title_bounds, bounds = map(checked_bounds, (row, title, target))
    require(title.get('class') == target.get('class') == 'android.widget.TextView',
            'public anchor title/summary class differs')
    for box in (title_bounds, bounds):
        require(row_bounds[0] <= box[0] < box[2] <= row_bounds[2]
                and row_bounds[1] <= box[1] < box[3] <= row_bounds[3],
                'public anchor title/summary leaves its actual row')
    text = target.get('text')
    require(isinstance(text, str) and '\0' not in text and len(text.encode()) <= 4096,
            'public anchored text absent or oversized')
    typed_value = {'selector_schema': 'hepta.public-text-anchor.v150.1',
                   'title_view_id': title_view_id, 'anchor_text': anchor_text,
                   'value_view_id': value_view_id, 'text': text,
                   'utf8_sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                   'row_bounds': row_bounds, 'anchor_bounds': title_bounds, 'bounds': bounds,
                   'relation': 'same_direct_preference_text_container'}
    observed.pop('values')
    return {**observed, 'anchor_value': typed_value}, viewport
